content: Iesu Sabu 5,000 Ibayues
Ra fani gibunai, Iesu imatabir men Galilee kamit irabon (o on kamit mat on seyoyorai Tiberias kamit).
Sabu kuayo gagamin on On sibigibubunuai yabin osi sit On bobo buburis ifouren sabu sawauis on ibiyawasis.
Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat sigai oyau tefanai ato nan simair.
Jew yangan asi Baisobon an Forag ra on inat iufin.
Iesu iyeit ato sabu kuayo gagamin ites on, On aurin si’nat, on mes On Philip aurin iyau, “Ot menan nan bayu tantobonen atonio osi sabu engon tutufin tanibayues i?”
(On atonio dura ikakafun on Philip itrutobonai mes; ato Iesu on isagob nono bobo mamaba itafour weie Philip itetemai.)

Philip iyafotai iyau, “Bayu tanabo sabu engon tutufin auris gugud gugud tanfasararam sinboboai on rafi sarar an baiyan on arimon agim 200 kina on tefanai nanaba tantobonen ato baise arimon men fofonin tanibayues on.”
On an baigibubunuotin tani wabin Andrew, Simon Peter tain on iyau,
“Fifi tani atonio nin on aurin rafi sarar nim a iyan ruam on sen. Baise on bayu on men fofonin sabu engon tutufin sinam on?”
Iesu iyawures iyau, “Sabu wawures sinmairirin.” (On efanai nan on engon wayo wat.) On mes sabu engon tutufin nan simairirin; on sabu amosi orot wat on engon 5,000.
Iesu rafi sarar ibo God aurin ikakaiu ato sabu nan simama on iraramis. On bobo kaitamom nanaba on iyan aurin ifour, God aurin ikakaiu ato osi engon tutufin asi gogoi mamaba on iraramis.
Osi engon tutufin siyam siyakokor weie, On an baigibubunuotis auris iyau, “Bayu tam tuturis sen on engon wonabo; men tuturis fani wonikiriren mes.”
Rafi sarar nim emon siyam ato tuturis on siboen kaifet engon auyotoat sasagis ruam on awas sibonuen.
Sabu nan on Iesu sit bobo buburin ifour ato siyau, “Dura bag atonio Orot on aubairuruotin, On tamomousin itnat au tafanam mes!”
Iesu isagob osi on kafakakai mom sitnat sitboai, ato asi gogoi nan sitiyamai itiaiwab mes; on mes On ekesin mom inai men oyauai nan.
Iesu Kamit tefanai Ibib
Ibirabirabi ato Iesu an baigibubunuotis on sisur sinai kamitai nan,
osi wa tefanai sikaruge ato simatabir men sirabon sinai au Capernaum. Awam ifom ato Iesu on oyauai nan, On men inat auris igat on.
Namon yabat wawanin isisin ato kamit iyamai nufur ibogagai.
Baigibubunuotis on wa siboi sinai, an weromin on kilomita nim o nimtereban kaita on nanaba ato osi sit Iesu kamit tefanai ibib inat wa aurin iufin; ato osi on men sunub siber on.
Iesu iyawures iyau, “Omi men wonaber mes, nin on Yau!”
Namon osi yasisirai wat Iesu sibo wayai siwan, ato ra kaita wa mutfon menan siyein si’nan on sinat on efanai nan sigat.
Sabu Iesu Sinuen
Ra itom sabu kuayo ato kamit reban emon simama on sit on wa kaitamom wat on nan iyoyot. Osi sisagob Iesu on men an baigibubunuotis mat wayai sinai on, ab osi ekesis wat sinai.
Wa fani Tiberias emon sinat toreai nan, on efan bisinai nan on Bada rafi sarar ikakaiu ato sabu kuayo gagamin ites siyam.
Sabu kuayo sit Iesu a an baigibubunuotis on men nan on, osi ato wa siyoyot on tefasi sikaruge ato sinai au Capernaum mafam gagaminai nan sinunuen.
Iesu on Rafi Sarar Yayawasin
Sabu on Iesu nan kamit reban emon sigaturai ato aurin siyau, “Baibebeotim, Om meyan unat nin ugat?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Yau awurem dura bag: Omi Yau wonunueniu yabin omi rafi sarar ami gogoi on ato wam woiyakokor, men ato Yau bobo buburis afofour on woit woitutum on.

Omi men bayu ato inkomas aurin on wonabo mes; baise omi bayu ato yawas mama wantoanin inen on aurin on wonabo. Atonio bayu on arimon Orot Natun initem yabin God Taman on an kufofot On aurin iyein, On aurin idura bag.”
On mes osi sitetemai siyau, “Wei mamaba wanafour onai wei God an bobo wanabo i?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Omi atonio bobo on God egogoi wonabo: Orot ato God Ibiyafarai on wonitutumai.”
Osi siyafotai siyau, “Om abi bobo buburin unafour onai wei wanitai ato wanitutumem? Om abi bobo unafour i?
Ot wawat agirit on efan koiteterinai nan bayu wabin manna on siyam, on nanaba dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, ‘Moses on rafi sarar safam emon on ites siyam.’”
Iesu iyau, “Yau awurem dura bag: rafi sarar ato Moses ibitem on men safam emon on; Yau Tamau on rafi sarar maiauin safam emon on item.
Yabin rafi sarar ato God ibitem on, On Iyafan safam emon isusur on yawas sabu tafanamai ebites.”
Osi sifefeyanai siyau, “Bada, atonio rafi sarar on ra fufur unitei.”
Iesu iyawures iyau, “Yau on rafi sarar yayawasin. Iyai iyafan Yau auriu innat on men bitanan ingiai on; iyai iyafan Yau inbitutumeu on men anjon sareu intein on.
Baise awurem, omi on basit Yau bobo buburis afour matamui woiteu ato omi arimon men wonitutumeu on.
Sabu engon tutufin Yau Tamau ibiteu on arimon sinnat auriu. Yau men arimon iyafan tani anisisiweiai ato osi sinnanat auriu on,
yabin Yau safam emon asusur on men Yau Tou au gogoiai anafour on, baise Iyafan ato ibiyafareu on an gogoiai anafour mes.
On Iyafan Yau ibiyafareu on egogoi atonio bobo anafour mes: sabu ato engon tutufin ibiteu on men tani anisiwanai mes baise ra kanfounai on engon tutufin anbobaimisires men sinyawas.
Yabin aifan Tamau an gogoi on atonio: sabu engon tutufin Natun sinitai a On sinbitutumai on, osi yawas mama wantoanin sinboai; ato Yau arimon ra kanfounai on anbobaimisires men sinyawas.”
Jew yangan on sibosuruf Iesu aurin on sigagam sibikakafun yabin On iyau, “Yau on rafi sarar on safam emon isur.”
On mes osi siyau, “Atonio Orot on Iesu, Joseph natun. Ot on On ayon taman tasagobis. Mamaba mes On ari ebikakafun yau, “On safam emon isur i?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Omi toum sanamui wogagam bonen on wonikirir.
Omi men iyafan tani auriu innat ab Tamau On ibiyafareu on inboai auriu innat; ato ra kanfounai on Yau arimon anbobaimisirai men inyawas.
Aubairuruotis dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, ‘God arimon sabu engon tutufin inibebeyes.’ Iyai iyafan Tamau aurin tainan erereben a On emon esasagob on auriu innat.
Yau abikakafun au, omi men iyafan tani Tamau matanai it ab Iyafan God emon i’nat On ekesin mom Tamau it.
Yau awurem dura bag: iyai iyafan ebitutum on yawas mama wantoanin inboai.
Yau on rafi sarar yayawasin.
Omi wawam agirim on bayu manna on efan koiteterinai nan siyam baise osi sirabob.
Baise rafi sarar ato safam emon isur on magin tani, ato iyai iyafan on i’nanin on men inarab.
Yau on rafi sarar yayawasin on safam emon isur. Iyai iyafan on rafi sarar i’nan on wantoan inama. Rafi sarar ato anbibitai on Yau biou on abitai, onai sabu tafanamai semama on yawas sinboai.”
Jew yangan sibosuruf tous amosi yatatabai sigagam bonen. Osi sibitetem si’yau, “Mamaba mes atonio Orot Toun bion on initet tanan mes i?”
Iesu osi auris iyau, “Yau awurem dura bag: omi men Orot Natun bion wonanin a an tara wontotoman, on men arimon toum amomui yawas wonboai on.
Iyai iyafan Yau biou inan a au tara intoman on yawas mama wantoanin inboai, ato ra kanfounai on anbobaimisirai men inyawas.
Yabin Yau biou on bayu maiauin; Yau au tara on sareu maiauin.
Iyai iyafan Yau biou i’nan a au tara intoman on Yau amoui inama ato Yau on amonai anama.
Tamau Yayawasin Iyafareu yabin On emon on Yau mat ifouriu amama. On eta kaitamomai, iyai iyafan Yau inaniu on anfourai inama.
Atonio rafi sarar on safam emon isur; atonio rafi sarar on men ato wawam agirim siyanin ba on, ato gibui sirabob. Iyafan atonio rafi sarar inanin on arimon wantoan inama.”
Iesu Capernaum mafam gagaminai nan bayoi goa amonai sabu ibibebeyes on atonio dura ikakafun.
Dura on Yawas Mama Wantoanin
On an baigibubunuotis sigaraba atonio dura sitatam ato siyau, “Atonio baibebe on iwani kwakwan. Iyafan On an dura intatam mes i?”
Iesu on men sikasonai baise On isagob osi atonio dura aurin on sigagamois, on mes On osi auris iyau, “Omi atonio baibebe iyamem on ami baitutum ifeu i?
Omi arimon Orot Natun wotitai itmatabir men itag itan ato an efan menan ainau imama on nan itgat on, omi arimon mamaba wotnos i?
God an Ayu on yawas ebitem, sabu tous on men fofonin atonio bobo sinafour on. Dura ato awurem on God an Ayu—an yawas ebitem.
Baise omi sabu fani on men wobitutum.” (Iesu anai bag on isagob nono, sabu iyabon on men sinitutumai ato iyafan on inkaseirai.)
Ato On an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Atonio yabinai on awurem, Tamau on aurin inibasitai on fofonin innat au baigibubunuotin inmatar.”
On yabinai Iesu an baigibubunuotis sigaraba on sikirir simatabir, men fofonin On mat nana sitabib on.
On mes Iesu on an baiyoyobotis auyotoat sasagis ruam on auris iyau, “Ato omi mat-wogogoi wonan i?”
Simon Peter iyafotai iyau, “Bada, wei on iyafan aurin wanan? Om am dura on yawas mama wantoanin initei.
Wei ari on wabitutum a wasagob Om on Kakafotim, God emon unat.”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Omi sabu auyotoat sasagis ruam on Yau arubinem au baigibubunuotim mes. Baise omi sanamui tani on afaguban!”
On min Judas, Simon Iscariot natun aurin on ibikakafun. Yabin Judas on baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagis ruam on tani, ato on arimon Iesu inkaseirai.
